pairs.evidence: lib/text/types.ts:365 The engine takes a prompt string the caller already built, plus inline audio bytes on the Google path (lib/text/providers/google.ts:348), and never opens a document container. A case-insensitive search of lib/text for pdf/ocr/docx/tesseract/mammoth/scanned/unreadable found nothing; the only 'extract' hit is extractJsonObject, which pulls JSON out of a model's answer rather than text out of a document, so none of the nine extraction techniques applies here.
